Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.network

Class PickerExportPacket

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.network.PickerExportPacket
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.network.protocol.common.custom.CustomPacketPayload
public class PickerExportPacket extends Object implements net.minecraft.network.protocol.common.custom.CustomPacketPayload
Client → server: "write this authored eye config for entityTypeId into the world datapack and reload" — the wire half of /sg export. The config travels as codec-encoded NBT (the same RuntimeConfig.CODEC the sync packet uses in the other direction); all validation, path construction, the 10-second cooldown, the file write, and the /reload live in PickerExportService. Like every picker verb it requires PickerGate.authorized(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer).

The client refuses to send a packet that fails fitsServerbound(), so a malformed or oversized packet only comes from a misbehaving client and fails decoding the way vanilla's do.
